title: CSL-Daily WER by preprint year
note: In 2023 the test-split and validation-split leaders differ, so the per-year answer is conditional.
caveat: Years are the first-submission year of the arXiv preprint that reports each number, not the year a method or result first appeared. The 2023 values were checked against arXiv 2305.03614v3; later versions rename the method and change results. In 2025, SLA-Adapter and SLA-LoRA tie at 25.8. This view groups records by preprint year; it is not a historical performance frontier.

title: WMT'14 English-French BLEU
note: No split was identified in the extracted records, so the official question cannot be answered.
